caption:
The other Tools as mentioned in the video:

Jules — Autonomous coding agent that fixes bugs, writes tests, and clears your GitHub backlog on its own.

Google Opal — Drag-and-drop builder that turns plain text prompts into working mini-apps and workflows.

Mixboard — AI whiteboard for brainstorming and mood boards, images and text on one canvas.

Google Pomelli — Scans your brand and generates on-brand social posts and ad creatives automatically.

AntiGravity — Google's agent-first coding IDE. Plans, writes, and fixes code across your whole project.

Stitch — Turns prompts into complete frontend UI designs and code.

Firebase Studio — Cloud dev environment that builds and deploys full-stack apps from a prompt.

Code Wiki — Turns your codebase into an interactive, searchable wiki.

Gemini Notebook — Source-grounded research assistant. Answers questions and builds study material from your own documents.

Disco — Turns your open browser tabs into custom AI-generated apps.

Doppl — Try on any outfit virtually using just a photo.

Learn Your Way — Turns notes and PDFs into personalized quizzes and study sessions.

Whisk — Remixes your own images into new AI-generated visuals.

Google AI Studio — Google's playground for building and testing apps with Gemini models.

Google Illuminate — Turns research papers into AI-generated audio summaries.

Hope it helps :)
